name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 3px focus ring to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This makes the target visible for keyboard users without cluttering the UI for mouse users. The trade-off is a tiny bit of extra visual noise, but it’s worth it for the 10% of users who rely on keyboards.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 3px ring with 4px offset still risks vanishing on dark or patterned backdrops, breaking WCAG 2.2 AA. Better: Use a 4px ring with 2px offset—it survives dark themes and meets 4.5:1 contrast. Settle it: Test the ring on a dark background and a busy pattern; if it fails, switch to a 4px ring with 2px offset.
